skill.summary: Claim and pay $1 to reserve a LocalSquare pin on a town's 10x10 grid, creating a local SEO webpage that appears in Google and AI search results.

latestVersion.changelog:
Version 2.0.2

- Clarified requirements and user flow for both wallet (x402) and non-wallet (website) users.
- Added an explicit section describing the option to direct non-crypto users to the website for monthly payments.
- Updated security notes, emphasizing that all discovery endpoints are free and noting differences in agent vs. website pricing.
- No file or functional changes; documentation improvement only.
